verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents a first-party MCP server that lets a user's AI assistant act on their behalf in the workspace, within the limits of their role. Fieldwork also accepts a natural-language control description for its AI agents to gather evidence. Together these enable natural-language operation, mostly routed through an external assistant rather than a native in-product command interface. Missing for 10: a documented native natural-language command interface in the product, documentation of which actions or tools the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: There are no keys to create or paste: add the Oneleet MCP server to your assistant, and it opens a browser window where you log in to Oneleet
Once connected, the assistant acts as you. It can only see and do what your own role in the workspace allows, and every action is attributed to your account.
Describe your control. Fieldwork's AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
